note: F01: brms multinomial on tier_f's counts m1, m2, m3 (row sums = size), written cbind(m1, m2, m3) | trials(size): brms evaluates cbind() into the matrix column it would take from the data (the same Stan program and standata); categories m1 (reference), m2, m3; one linear predictor per non-reference category, dpars mum2 and mum3 (X_mum2, X_mum3; Intercept_mum2, b_mum2, ...), each with its own (1 | g) term (sd_1 and Z_1_mum2_1 for mum2, sd_2 and Z_2_mum3_1 for mum3); standata Y (36 x 3), trials, ncat = 3; density multinomial_logit2(Y | (0, mu2, mu3)); linpred (draws, rows, 2), epred (draws, rows, 3) = trials * softmax(0, mu2, mu3) (checked on the frozen points)

brms.formula: cbind(m1, m2, m3) | trials(size) ~ x + (1 | g)
